name: Eco
description: Build a civilization in a fully simulated ecosystem — with laws, economy and government. Dedicated server installed via SteamCMD (anonymous).
notes: Configuration lives in Configs/*.eco (JSON): Network.eco for name/description/ports, Difficulty.eco for world settings. The web UI on the web port includes admin tools. World storage is in Storage/. Windows hosts: set the start command override to EcoServer.exe.
